item.title: Darwin's fox
item.description: You can adopt symbolic species to support WWF’s global efforts to protect wild animals and their habitats. Darwin’s fox’s conservation status is endangered, and the most important conservation concerns are forest fragmentation and threats posed by feral dogs, either by spreading diseases or directly attacking them.

item.title: Seventeen
item.description: One month after I started my postdoc in Lennon Lab, 17-year-old cicadas (Brood X) emerged. It was the most fascinating natural event I’ve seen. They were loud and everywhere, and I remember that once I biked 10 of them on me. Here is a little reminder.
